title: Divi 5 layout tree
description: A page as a JSON tree mirroring the D5 builder and the composition patterns. Nesting: blocks are sections; a section holds rows (row = flex columns whose widths fill the row, grid_row = any number of cards in equal tracks); a row/grid_row holds columns or card patterns (icon_card, media_card, person_card, testimonial_card, numbered_card, step_card, stat_card return a column: put them directly in the row, never inside a column or group); columns and groups hold modules, groups and the other patterns. Args use the PHP/Python parameter names. Prefer composition (group/icon/text/link and patterns) over blurb/testimonial/team_member/button.

builder_version.description: Divi version stamped on blocks (use the site's version, e.g. "5.14.0").

theme.description: Theme tokens passed to every pattern.

blocks.description: Top-level nodes: sections (also for Theme Builder headers/footers).

node.description: A node: a helper {"<helper>": {...args}}, a pattern {"pattern": "<name>", "args": {...}} or a raw block {"block": "divi/<name>", ...}.

pattern.description: Composition pattern (Patterns::<name>): cards and text pieces built from column/group/text/icon/image/link. Args are the parameter names.

block.description: Escape hatch: any Divi 5 block. children absent = self-closing block; [] = empty container.

attrs.description: Divi attributes deep-merged into the block (raw Divi 5 shape, e.g. {"module": {"decoration": {...}}}). Value helpers are resolved anywhere inside, and may produce the whole object (e.g. {"module_deco": {...}}).

value.description: Any JSON value. An object is a value helper call when exactly one of its keys is a helper name (rv, box, radius, color_var, content_var, fa, divi_icon, font, flex, grid, card, module_deco) and its other keys are that helper's siblings (fa: weight; color_var: opacity); otherwise it is a plain object whose values are resolved recursively. {"literal": X} yields X untouched.

string.description: A string (or number), or a helper that resolves to one ({"color_var": ...}, {"content_var": ...}).

object.description: An object (value helpers allowed inside, or a helper producing it: rv, flex, grid, box, font...).

theme.description: Design tokens for the patterns (Theme). Values may be plain colors or {"color_var": ...} / {"content_var": ...}. In a pattern's args.theme: tokens for that pattern only, merged over the top-level theme.

heading_font.description: Heading font family ("" = site default), e.g. "Red Hat Display".

eyebrow_font.description: Eyebrow font family ("" = site default), e.g. "Red Hat Mono".

card_hover_css.description: Card hover CSS ("" = default hover shadow), e.g. "transform: translateY(-4px);".

card_radius.description: Card radius: list (TL, TR, BR, BL) or a single value such as "16px".

node_section.description: Section. kind="fullwidth" for fullwidth modules. css_id for anchor links.

kind.description: Section type: "fullwidth" for fullwidth modules (leave out for regular sections).

css_id.description: CSS id on the section for anchor links, e.g. "becas" (linked as "#becas").

node_row.description: Flex row containing columns. Writes columnStructure/flexColumnStructure and each column's flexType so the Visual Builder shows the right layout. Widths must fill the row (sum = 1) or fill it several times (e.g. eight 1_4 columns = two lines of four).

wrap_on.description: Breakpoints where multi-column rows wrap (columns stack full width on phone).

children.description: Columns: column nodes or card patterns. Widths must fill the row (sum 1, or 2, 3... full lines).

node_grid_row.description: CSS-grid row: any number of columns (cards) flow into `cols` equal tracks (tablet/phone counts too). template="2fr 1fr" for manual tracks instead.

template.description: Manual track sizes instead of cols, e.g. "2fr 1fr".

children.description: Columns: column nodes or card patterns (any number; they flow into cols tracks).

node_column.description: Column. width like "1_2", "1_3", "2_3", "3_5" (or "1/2"). tablet/phone override widths; row() fills defaults once it knows the column count.

width.description: Column width: "1_1", "1_2", "1_3", "2_3", "1_4", "3_4", "3_5"... (or "1/2"). Widths in a row must add up to whole lines.

node_group.description: Group: a flex (or grid) container for modules. layout = a full flex()/grid() value instead of the shortcut options. tablet / phone = layout overrides (e.g. {"flexDirection": "column"}).

direction.description: Flex direction: row | column | row-reverse | column-reverse.

justify.description: justify-content: start | center | end | space-between | space-around.

wrap.description: Flex wrap: true, false or a CSS value.

layout.description: Full layout value instead of the shortcuts: {"flex": {...}} or {"grid": {...}}.

url.description: Link URL when the image is clicked.

node_link.description: Link module: text + optional icon, styleable as a pill button.

new_window.description: Open the link in a new tab.

node_heading.description: Heading module (plain text title, configurable tag).

new_window.description: Open the link in a new tab.

node_blurb.description: Blurb. icon = font-icon dict, e.g. fa_icon(""). Or image_src for an image.

image_src.description: Image URL instead of an icon.

number.description: Number or short label, e.g. "01" or "98%".

node_cta.description: Call To Action module (title, text, button in one box).

node_testimonial.description: Testimonial. portrait is an image URL (stored as portrait.innerContent.src).

node_contact_form.description: Contact form with contact_field() children. email = recipient (empty = site admin). unique_key makes the form's uniqueId stable (uuid5 in the URL namespace); without it a random uuid4 is used.

unique_key.description: Stable key for the form id (same key = same id on rebuild).

node_contact_field.description: Contact form field. type: input | email | text (textarea) | checkbox | radio | select. half=true puts it at 50% width on tablet/desktop (full width on phone).

type.description: Field type: input | email | text | checkbox | radio | select.

node_timeline.description: Timeline with timeline_item() children. position: right | left | alternating.

node_icon_list_item.description: Icon list item (default icon: Font Awesome check).

node_social_follow.description: Social Media Follow with social_network() children.

node_social_network.description: Social network. network: facebook, twitter, instagram, linkedin, youtube, tiktok, pinterest, ...

network.description: Network slug: facebook, x, instagram, linkedin, youtube...

node_breadcrumbs.description: Breadcrumbs module (Home > parent > current page, resolved by WordPress).

pattern_eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above a heading.

pattern_heading_text.description: Heading as a Text module (<h1>..<h6> inside), styled via headingFont.

pattern_body_text.description:
Paragraph text. `html` may be plain text (wrapped in

) or HTML.

pattern_section_header.description: Eyebrow + heading (in a group) and an optional intro paragraph: 1-2 blocks, spread into the parent column/group.

eyebrow_label.description: Eyebrow label above the title (empty string = none).

pattern_icon_badge.description: Icon inside a tinted square/circle. shape: circle | soft (card radius) | square.

pattern_number_badge.description: "01"-style number in a tinted circle (Text module).

number.description: Number or short label, e.g. "01" or "98%".

pattern_pill_link.description: Link styled as a pill button. variant: primary (filled) | outline | text. The hover state must contrast with the section behind the button, not only with the button itself. on_dark=true (button on a dark/brand background) switches to a light hover: white fill with the button color as text. bg/fg/hover_bg/hover_fg override any of the four colors explicitly. The link icon inherits the text color (normal and hover), so no icon color is written unless icon_color / icon_hover_color ask for a different one.

new_window.description: Open the link in a new tab.

on_dark.description: Button sits on a dark/brand background: light hover (white fill).

icon_color.description: Icon color, only when it must differ from the text.

icon_hover_color.description: Icon hover color, only when it must differ from the text.

body.description:
Body text (plain text is wrapped in

width.description: Column width when the card sits in a flex row ("1_3"...). Leave out in a grid_row.

tablet.description: Tablet width in a flex row.

phone.description: Phone width in a flex row.

value_rv.description: Responsive value -> {"desktop": {"value": ..., "hover"?: ...}, "tablet"?: {"value": ...}, ...}. Most Divi attribute leaves need it.

value_box.description: Spacing box (margin/padding) with Divi sync flags. List in CSS shorthand order (1 to 4 values) or an object.

value_radius.description: Border radius: one value (uniform) or 4 values [top_left, top_right, bottom_right, bottom_left].

value_color_var.description: Reference to a global color: "gcid-..." (optional sibling "opacity") or {"id": "gcid-...", "opacity": n}.

value_content_var.description: Reference to a global variable (number, text, font, link...): "gvid-...".

value_fa.description: Font Awesome icon value, e.g. {"fa": ""} or {"fa": "", "weight": "400"}.

value_font.description: Font settings for an element. group="font" -> {element: {decoration: {font: {font: rv(...)}}}} (titles, buttons) group="bodyFont" -> needs sub="body"|"link"|"ul"|"ol"|"quote" (rich text body) group="headingFont" -> needs sub="h1".."h6" (headings inside rich text)

desktop.description: Font values: size, weight, color, lineHeight, letterSpacing, family, style...

group.description: "font" (titles, buttons), "bodyFont" (rich text, needs sub) or "headingFont" (needs sub).

sub.description: bodyFont: body | link | ul | ol | quote; headingFont: h1..h6.

value_flex.description: Value for decoration.layout in flex mode (sections, rows, columns, groups, links, icons). direction: row | column | row-reverse | column-reverse justify: start | center | end | space-between | space-around align: flex-start | center | flex-end | stretch gap sets both rowGap and columnGap; row_gap/column_gap override. wrap: true -> "wrap", false -> "nowrap", or a CSS value.

direction.description: Flex direction: row | column | row-reverse | column-reverse.

justify.description: justify-content: start | center | end | space-between | space-around.

wrap.description: Flex wrap: true, false or a CSS value.

value_grid.description: Value for decoration.layout in CSS grid mode. columns=3 -> equal columns (gridColumnWidths "equal", gridColumnCount "3") template="42px 1fr" -> manual track sizes (gridColumnWidths "manual", gridTemplateColumns)

justify.description: justify-content: start | center | end | space-between | space-around.

value_card.description: Card look for a column, group or row. radius: "16px" or a 4-item list (topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft). padding: "24px" or box(...) dict. shadow / hover_shadow: dicts of boxShadow keys, e.g. {"vertical": "10px", "blur": "28px"}.

radius.description: Radius: "16px" or 4 values [TL, TR, BR, BL].

value_module_deco.description: {"module": {"decoration": {groups}}}: decoration groups such as background, border, spacing, sizing, layout, boxShadow, font (values usually rv).

value_literal.description: Literal value: returned as is, nothing inside is resolved. Use it for an object whose key collides with a helper name, e.g. {"literal": {"font": {"font": {...}}}}.
